newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds ease in line with Europe.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds ease in line with Europe.

text.p: 1200 GMT - Portuguese bonds eased with Europe in light trade ahead of the Bank of Portugal's rates announcement at 1415 GMT.
*Spread vs Spanish 10-yr cash -2 bps vs -1 bps cls
Portuguese bonds eased in sympathy with Europe in cautious trade ahead of a rates announcement by the Bank of Portugal at 1415 GMT.

Most economists polled by Reuters said that the Bank of Portugal was expected to trim its absorption rate, which now stands at 6.2 percent, when it announces money market conditions for the next central bank accounting period.
The spread between 10-year Portuguese bonds and Bonos remained flat and was not expected to change much, dealers said.
The escudo was firm against the German mark in morning trade and pressured the psychological level of 99.50 per mark. It stood at 99.47/99.50 per mark at 1203 GMT.
Dealers said the escudo would stay in line with the peseta throughout today's session.
